component.name: Auriscope
component.summary: Play a file and see it: waveform, spectrogram, spectrum

description.p: Auriscope is a read-only audio player and analyser. Open a file and it shows the waveform, a whole-file spectrogram and a live spectrum, with loudness and level measurements alongside.

ul.li: Waveform with min/max envelope, RMS overlay, dB scale and up to 4096x vertical zoom
Whole-file spectrogram that refines itself as you zoom, with optional time-frequency reassignment for razor-thin harmonics
Palettes: Amber, Ember, Magma, Inferno, Viridis, Plasma, Turbo, Grey and a custom three-colour gradient
Merged view: the waveform drawn over the spectrogram, each with its own opacity
Integrated, short-term and momentary loudness, loudness range, sample and true peak, RMS, DC offset, clipping count
RIFF/WAVE header inspector: chunks, Broadcast Wave metadata, INFO tags and cue markers
Loop ranges on the time ruler with draggable handles
Decodes WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC, ALAC, APE, MP3, AAC, Vorbis, Opus in Ogg, MP4 and Matroska containers

description.p: Auriscope never writes to your files.

screenshot.caption: A log sweep and a tone, with the clipped region flagged in red

description.p: Capture what you are looking at: save the current view as a PNG, and its measurements alongside as JSON, so a finding can leave the app and go into a report or a ticket.
A recently opened list, so returning to a file you were working on no longer means finding it again.
A help mode that explains what each part of the window is showing, for the parts of an analyser that are not self-evident.
An output meter with peak detection, and per-channel isolation alongside the existing mute and solo.
A clearer settings dialog, with key hints on the controls that have keyboard shortcuts.
An application icon in the title bar, the taskbar and the window manager.

Auriscope now tells you when a newer release is available, checked once a day against GitHub and turned off in Settings. Distribution packages leave the check out; your package manager handles updates.
